<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Torrent in the Blood](/Feats.aspx?ID=4273) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=89" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Vitality" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=509" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 32

</column>

---

A healing wave splashes across creatures in a 30-foot cone, its cleansing water driving afflictions from the body. Each creature in the area regains 3d8 Hit Points and can attempt a new save against one [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) or [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) affliction affecting it; on a failed save, the condition doesn't worsen.

 Each creature that benefited from this impulse becomes temporarily immune to Torrent in the Blood for 10 minutes.

---
**Level (+2)** The healing increases by 1d8.
name: Torrent in the Blood
